subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

         lnormal = normal

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form

  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then
    write(display,*)trim(a_message_char1)
  else
    write(display,form)trim(a_message_char1)

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else

      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      implicit none

      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace

#ifdef USEMPI

#else

      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.

         call backtrace

#ifdef USEMPI

#else
      stop 1
#endif

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine writelog_a(destination, form, a_message_char1)
  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then
    write(display,*)trim(a_message_char1)
  else
    write(display,form)trim(a_message_char1)
  endif
  ! this is the main subroutine that actual does the logging
  ! passing the trimmed version of display does not work.
  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))
end subroutine writelog_a

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

      implicit none
      integer ierr

      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then

  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine writelog_a(destination, form, a_message_char1)
  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then
    write(display,*)trim(a_message_char1)
  else
    write(display,form)trim(a_message_char1)

  ! this is the main subroutine that actual does the logging

  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif

      implicit none

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form

  if (trim(form)=='') then

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then

      else

      endif
#else
      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine writelog_a(destination, form, a_message_char1)
  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then
    write(display,*)trim(a_message_char1)
  else
    write(display,form)trim(a_message_char1)
  endif
  ! this is the main subroutine that actual does the logging

  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none

  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form

      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank

         call backtrace

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine writelog_a(destination, form, a_message_char1)
  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then
    write(display,*)trim(a_message_char1)
  else
    write(display,form)trim(a_message_char1)
  endif
  ! this is the main subroutine that actual does the logging
  ! passing the trimmed version of display does not work.
  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

subroutine halt_program(normal)
      logical,intent(in),optional :: normal
      logical                     :: lnormal
      integer                     :: ierr

      if(present(normal)) then
         lnormal = normal
      else
         lnormal = .true.
      endif

      write(0,*) 'halt_program called by process', xmpi_orank
      if (lnormal) then
         call backtrace
      endif

#ifdef USEMPI
      if (lnormal) then
         call xmpi_abort
      else
         call MPI_Abort(xmpi_ocomm,1,ierr)
      endif
#else
      stop 1
#endif
   end subroutine halt_program

subroutine xmpi_abort
      ! to be used if program has to end, and there is no way
      ! to tell other processes about this fact
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Abort(xmpi_comm,1,ierr)
      stop 1
   end subroutine xmpi_abort

  implicit none
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  destination
  character(*),intent(in)    ::  form
  character(len=slen) :: display
  character(*), intent(in) :: a_message_char1
  if (trim(form)=='') then

  call writelog_distribute(destination, trim(display))
